Our Journey

From day one, built to ship

A young company moving fast, every milestone is a system in production and a client outcome behind it.

2017

It begins in Karachi

DigiWorks is founded on one conviction: most projects fail in the gap between what clients ask for and what their business actually needs. Closing that gap is the whole idea.

2019

Across the globe

Expansion beyond Pakistan into the USA (Austin HQ), the UAE, and Canada, registered and operating across four countries.

2019–2024

Scale

Five offices and 150+ production AI deployments across 7+ sectors, from Austin HQ, with typical first production inside 8–20 weeks for named work.

2025

DigiWorks AI launches

As AI moves to the core, the AI-native brand is born, intelligent systems and AI-native product development built to reach production.

Today

Two brands, one company

DigiWorks Digital Inc. runs DigiWorks Digital for custom software and digital transformation, and DigiWorks AI for AI-native products, measured by outcomes, not launches.
